verdict.rationale: The pack has no documented API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. The only hint is a '/api/v1/' path seen in a runtime probe, which is an incidental URL detail rather than a documented versioning or deprecation commitment. No changelog, sunset notice, or version-support policy appears, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
